name: Bokeh defocus
description: Throws the frame out of focus on a golden-angle spiral, so 40 taps cover the aperture disc evenly instead of clumping on an axis. Highlights bloom into discs rather than smearing. The focal plane is a band across the frame that drifts, so something is always sharp.

radius.description: Aperture size — how far out of focus the blurred region goes.

focus.description: Where the sharp band sits, 0 bottom to 1 top.

depth.description: Width of the sharp band. Large values keep the whole frame in focus.

bloom.description: Extra weight given to bright taps, which is what turns highlights into discs.
